name: prism-analytics
description: Runs backend + worker + frontend together without Docker. See README.md.

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run prisma:generate --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c cyan,yellow,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev:worker --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
